1.s: The elder writes to “the chosen lady and her children”, rejoicing that some walk in the truth. Love one another; that is the command from the beginning. Don’t welcome deceivers who deny that Jesus came in the flesh.
1.d: “The elder” is how John speaks of himself. “The chosen lady” could be a woman’s name (Greek kuria), but more likely means a local church and its members [[tosn:2 John 1:1]] [[bsn:2 John 1:1-13]]; “your chosen sister” would then be a sister church [[tosn:2 John 1:13]].
